notes: Feel pass: the mouse wheel scrolls the hotbar (items in slots 4-6 are used with left click). Walk (Alt), run and sprint (Shift), with walk/run animations matched to ground speed so feet stay planted, plus jump take-off and landing. F4 toggles first person anywhere. Hold F for interaction mode: a cursor, hover labels, click to use doors, consoles and more; click a console's screen to focus on it and press its rows directly. Tap F works as before.
